tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search UK retail products by keyword, brand, MPN, or GTIN and return multiple matching candidates with price ranges and merchant counts.

tools.name: compare_prices
tools.description: Compare live UK prices across merchants by barcode (GTIN-13, EAN) or search query.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: List canonical UK retail categories with product counts and Category Intelligence publication status.

tools.name: get_category_facets
tools.description: Discover published Category Intelligence facets, units, permitted options, qualifying product counts, and freshness metadata by category slug (e.g. laptops, monitors, keyboards).

tools.name: query_category
tools.description: Filter qualifying UK products within a category by rights-cleared Category Intelligence facets (from get_category_facets), brand, price range, and keywords.

tools.name: discover_products
tools.description: Discover and rank qualifying UK multi-merchant products from a natural-language request (e.g. 'best 16-inch laptop under £1,000 for graphic design'). Automatically resolves category, budget, specs, and use-case intent, and returns applied_constraints for follow-up refinement.

tools.name: refine_discovery
tools.description: Refine a previous discover_products result using conversational follow-ups such as 'cheaper', 'more powerful', 'better energy efficiency', 'only in stock', or explicit new constraints.

tools.name: compare_products
tools.description: Compare 2 to 5 UK products side-by-side on category-specific specifications, live UK prices, spreads, stock, and evidence-backed trade-offs.

tools.name: list_merchants
tools.description: List verified UK merchants with product counts, reliability scores, and active voucher counts.

tools.name: get_merchant
tools.description: Retrieve a verified UK merchant profile, reliability score, and active promotional vouchers by slug or merchant ID.

tools.name: get_alternatives
tools.description: Find comparable UK product alternatives for a given barcode (GTIN) or search query.

tools.name: get_product_evidence
tools.description: Retrieve rights-cleared deterministic identity, merchant observation, and data-provenance evidence for a product.

tools.name: list_deals
tools.description: Browse today's top UK price-spread deals and spotlight drops across verified retailers.

tools.name: list_outlet_deals
tools.description: Browse verified refurbished, open-box, and graded UK outlet deals with warranty details and savings vs brand new.

tools.name: list_pro_deals
tools.description: Browse UK commercial, B2B, and trade equipment price spreads across specialist sectors.

tools.name: list_vouchers
tools.description: Discover active UK retailer promo codes and promotional deals with tracked voucher links.

tools.name: get_product_family
tools.description: Compare all variants (storage, RAM, colour, size) in a product family by family ID, slug, variant GTIN, or family name.

tools.name: resolve_product
tools.description: Resolve a manufacturer part number (MPN) and optional brand name to deterministic UK GTIN barcodes and comparison URLs.

tools.name: compare_batch
tools.description: Compare up to 10 GTIN barcodes at once and calculate the cheapest split-merchant basket vs. best single-merchant basket (including delivery).

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search UK retail products by keyword, brand, MPN, or GTIN (OpenAI Deep Research compatible).

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Fetch full live UK pricing, delivery, refurbished outlet offers, and tracked purchase links for a product ID/GTIN (OpenAI Deep Research compatible).

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "compare_prices" appears informational but accepts parameters (history) that enable code/file/secret access.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.
